scientific_integrity: The proof is a necessary-and-sufficient construction for all prescribed multiplicities, with an explicit residue-class impossibility argument. Exhaustive finite verification corroborates, not replaces, the proof. No external mathematical review was performed.
scientific_limitations: Existence classification for circular lengths 1,2,3 only, n>=3. No count of realizing matchings; no general solution for arbitrary prescribed distances. Parity and two-length cases predate this contribution. Publication priority and independence are not established.
title: The complete three-short-distance seating-couples criterion
